findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Why RITVA" above "Make ESG meaningful to your business."; "Contact" above "Every responsible journey starts somewhe"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 21 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "ESG intelligence platform", "Earth", "People", "Governance").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.bar 1320px | li 304px | li 304px | li 304px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt EB Garamond and EB Garamond, but the page renders Inter, Cormorant Garamond.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 60px on the left, 118px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Little motion: 11 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Understand what responsible business means today" → 3 lines (6 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
